name: Langflow
description: Langflow is a visual low-code builder for AI agents and RAG workflows. Drag components such as language models, vector stores and tools onto a canvas, test the flow in the built-in playground, and serve it as an API or MCP server. It works with OpenAI-compatible endpoints, local models through Ollama and the major cloud providers.

notes.text: Sign in with LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER and LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD from /opt/langflow_data/.env.

Model servers, vector stores and databases on your LAN are blocked until you add their host or subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24) to LANGFLOW_SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS in /opt/langflow_data/.env and restart Langflow.
